items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-10-02
items.q: I didn't know him. I heard of him.

ctx.x: Well, I wasn't paying much attention to bass, but I was listening to the old band.
The bass player was from New Orleans, Steve Brown. Do you remember him? I heard of him.

I didn't know him. I heard of him. He left here before. He played with the rhythm keys. Yeah. But back in those days, they wanted to be steady and swing, you know, just a little emphasis on that third beat, on the second and fourth beat, rather. Yeah. And... Syncopation?
